desc: Derive and document the transformed cost identity that eliminates the subarray index i.
Implement the O(n^2) transformed cut-penalty DP with prefix sums and correct handling of internal cuts, the final endpoint, and the constant k * total_cost.
Test on the provided examples and small random cases against a brute-force partition checker.
Verify complexity is O(n^2) time and O(n) memory, and check edge cases such as n = 1.
